messages:
rachel: Thinking of hosting a small LAN Friday at 6:30pm in the lounge. Theme: "couch vs PC" — split between Steam Decks/Handhelds and desktop rigs. Who's in and what can you bring (switch, power, monitor)?

jon: In for PC side. I can bring a 27" monitor + HDMI and a handful of spare USB-C cables.

karen: Bringing my Deck! Also a USB-C -> HDMI dongle and 45W PD bank.

pete: I can bring a cheap 5-port switch and some Cat6s. Also have an extra PS4 controller if anyone wants to try couch co-op.

vince: RSVP: Vince - Switch + dock + Mario Kart cart. Also i'll bring snacks (chips).

rachel: Awesome. Can someone bring a power strip with long cable? The lounge outlets are all on one wall.

jon: I have a 6-outlet strip and a 10m extension.

karen: Tiny ask: anyone got a USB Bluetooth dongle? My controller's battery is flaky and I don't want to fight pairing.

pete: got one. i'll label it with tape so it doesn't walk off.

lan-bot: Reminder: RSVP by Thursday 3pm. Current headcount: 8. Please list primary device (PC/Deck/Switch/Handheld).

rachel: Quick poll: do we want to do a short bracket tournament (Smash/Street Fighter) or a chill freeplay? React with :trophy: for bracket, :popcorn: for freeplay.

jon: :trophy:

karen: :popcorn:

pete: :trophy: (if we can do rounds of 5-10 mins max)

vince: :popcorn: unless someone brings a projector for spectating.

rachel: Cool split. We'll do casual freeplay and a single elimination surprise tourney around 9pm if enough folks down.

rachel: Final checklist (tiny):
- switch + patch cables
- power strips + extension
- extra controllers + chargers
- dongles + HDMI dongle for Decks
- snacks/drinks (bring your own cup)

rachel: If you need to swap game copies or controllers before Friday, DM me. See you at 6:30!
